_doc: Sand Brood fourth faction (game/WildFactionManager.ts, same schema as seaFolk.json). The Ancient Caterpillar, a Deity's pet, rules the ground beneath the island; battles shaking the earth raise 'contamination' (here: unrest). Above emergeAt a brood of Arachnids and Scorpions bursts out of the ground when a wave or brawl starts and fights demons, humans AND the Sea Folk; at bossAt (or at random, also in brawls: boss.inBrawls) the Caterpillar itself surfaces. Where it surfaces it heaves the ground in a rounded patch (terrain.carveRadius tiles): sea becomes sand, sand becomes land, land becomes raised rock that only flyers cross and that settles back into land the next day; sand settles back into land after terrain.sandDays days. Tribute calms it like the Sea Folk.

desc.en: Eight-legged hunters that spit sticky silk from a distance.
desc.tl: Walong-paang mangangaso na dumudura ng malagkit na sapot mula sa malayo.

skillDesc.en: Slows its target with a glob of silk.
skillDesc.tl: Pinababagal ang kalaban gamit ang buo ng sapot.

desc.en: Armoured pincers and a venom tail; it digs out right under its prey.
desc.tl: Nakabaluting sipit at buntot na may lason; humuhukay ito mismo sa ilalim ng biktima.

skillDesc.en: Its next strike lands with venom for more than double damage.
skillDesc.tl: Ang susunod na tama ay may lason at higit doble ang pinsala.

desc.en: Dives into the ground and bursts out under the farthest foe, throwing everyone near into the air.
desc.tl: Sumisisid sa lupa at sumasabog sa ilalim ng pinakamalayong kalaban, tinatamaan ang lahat ng malapit.

desc.en: Sprays a wide net of silk that snares every foe in reach.
desc.tl: Nagbubuga ng malawak na lambat ng seda na bumibitag sa lahat ng kalaban na maaabot.

desc.en: Churns the ground into a sinking vortex that drags foes in and turns the land to sand.
desc.tl: Ginagawang lumulubog na ipoipo ang lupa na humihila sa mga kalaban at ginagawang buhangin ang lupa.

desc.en: A Deity's ancient pet that rules the ground below. It carves the land as it burrows.
desc.tl: Sinaunang alaga ng isang Diyos na naghahari sa ilalim ng lupa. Inuukit nito ang lupa habang humuhukay.

skillDesc.en: Three skills: Burrow Eruption, Silk Snare and Sand Vortex.
skillDesc.tl: Tatlong kakayahan: Pagsabog mula sa Hukay, Bitag na Seda at Ipoipo ng Buhangin.
